privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: Vivum is a Bible reading app that works fully offline. We do not collect, transmit, or sell any personal data.
privacy.s1Text: None. Vivum has no accounts and asks for no name, email, or personal information. No usage data is ever sent to a server — we operate none.
privacy.s2Text: The entire biblical text is bundled inside the app. Reading, searching, and browsing work without an Internet connection and generate no network traffic.
privacy.s3Text: Your preferences stay exclusively on your device, in the app's local storage:
privacy.s3Item1: Favorite verses (reference, text, and date added).
privacy.s3Item2: Chosen display language, last reading position and recent reading history.
privacy.s3Item3: This data never leaves your device unless you export it yourself. It is deleted if you clear the app data or uninstall the app.
privacy.s4Text: Vivum includes no trackers, no third-party cookies, no analytics tools, and no advertising. No advertising identifiers or audience measurement are used.
privacy.s5Text: The app contains links to GitHub (project page and developer profile). If you click these links, your browser is subject to GitHub's privacy policy, which is independent of this policy.
privacy.s6Text: Vivum is suitable for all ages and knowingly collects no data about children.
privacy.s7Text: Since no personal data is collected or transmitted, there is nothing for us to review, export, or correct. You stay in full control: you can delete your favorites and preferences at any time from within the app or by clearing local data.
privacy.s8Text: For any question about this policy, open an issue at https://github.com/Martzcode/Vivum. If changes are made, the update date above will be revised.
privacy.manageText: You can delete your favorites and reading history at any time. This action is permanent.
privacy.cleared: Your favorites and reading history have been deleted.
